📝"Gerans" on Deployment📝
How might North Korea use the new drones?

A new report from a monitoring group shed light on cooperation between Russia and North Korea in the field of drone production. Whether the data is actually accurate remains unknown, but there's another interesting angle here.

The group includes representatives from South Korea, Japan and the USA. And they are likely far more concerned not with sanctions compliance — after all, if North Korea acquires drones from the "Geranium" series, it will deal another blow to the security of all three countries.

In Seoul, Tokyo and Washington, they understand that acquiring the same "Geran-5s" would give North Koreans even more capability to strike key targets in the region. The most vulnerable point, of course, is the completely exposed South Korean territory, but Japan could also take hits if things escalate.

🔻North Korea's Priority Targets:

▪️On the territory of North Korea's Asian neighbors, important American bases are concentrated. For example, Camp Humphreys serves as the headquarters of US forces in South Korea, and US Air Force assets are concentrated at airbases Osan and Kunsan, while the naval facility in Sasebo could also be hit. Military installations of Japanese and South Korean forces will also be tempting targets for "Geraniums."

▪️North Koreans clearly won't forget about the economy either. Literally 100 kilometers from the demilitarized zone lies the world's largest cluster of Samsung factories — the company ranks second only to Taiwan's TSMC in chip production. If a strike disrupts operations at these facilities, it would hurt not only South Korea's budget but the global technology industry as well.

▪️And if Pyongyang decides to halt South Korea's economy altogether, they would pull out a map showing oil refineries and energy facilities like power plants. Since the southern neighbor depends on energy imports and relies on exporting its goods due to its economic structure, major ports could well become the next targets.

▪️The same applies to Japan. In the country, within the strike radius of "Geraniums," there are several large fuel storage facilities and refineries, as well as port installations — just one port, Nagoya, handles one of the world's largest cargo flows. Factories of Toyota, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, and technology companies could also come under fire.

📌North Korea is clearly watching closely what's happening in so-called Ukraine and the Middle East. This is indicated by their recent practice of combined strikes — North Koreans hit with both missiles and drones. In other words, Pyongyang hasn't forgotten about scenarios involving air defense saturation of a potential adversary and destruction of important targets.

❗️And the Geran-5 drones, in theory, would help bring such plans to life in the event of a conflict. An American and allied attack on North Korea would already be costly, considering the presence of nuclear weapons. But if relations deepen with Russia, that cost risks becoming even higher.

👉 ઇતિહાસમાં હડપ્પા સંસ્કૃતિ અને તેના સ્થળો, મૌર્ય - ગુપ્ત કાળ અને આધુનિક ભારતના ઇતિહાસના પ્રશ્નો હતા.. સામાજિક ધાર્મિક સુધારણાના પ્રશ્નો પણ પૂછાય છે. 
👉 બંધારણના સરળથી મધ્યમ લેવલના પ્રશ્નો આવે છે. અનુચ્છેદ, મૂળભૂત હકો, રાષ્ટ્રપતિ, સુપ્રીમ કોર્ટ, પંચાયતી રાજ વગેરે ટોપિકના પ્રશ્નો
👉 ઇકોનોમીના પ્રશ્નો ક્યારેક વિધાનવાળા હોય છે તો અમુક શિફ્ટમાં એનાલિસિસ પ્રકારના પ્રશ્નો આવે છે. 
👉 ભૂગોળ અને વિજ્ઞાનમાં સીધા વનલાઇનર પ્રશ્નો આવે છે. 
👉 કરંટમાં વિવિધ રિપોર્ટમાં પહેલો ક્રમ, ભારતનો ક્રમ, કોણ બહાર પાડે છે વગેરે; નામાંકિત એવોર્ડ્સ કે પુરસ્કાર (જેમ કે ગ્રામી એવોર્ડ્સ); ભારત અને ગુજરાતના વર્તમાન પદાધિકારીઓ (જેમ કે મંત્રી, રાજ્યપાલ, CAG); મહત્ત્વના દિવસો, રમતગમતના પ્રશ્નો, સરકારી યોજનાઓ વિશેના પ્રશ્નો; GI ટેગ ના પ્રશ્નો છે. 

કોઈ જોડકા જોડો, પ્રશ્નોની અંદર બીજા પ્રશ્નો હોય એવા લાંબા કે એકદમ પ્રો લેવલના પ્રશ્નો નથી પૂછાતા.. ઠીક ઠાક તૈયારી હોય તો ઘણા પ્રશ્નો આવડી જાય છે.

➼ Raigarh, Chhattisgarh में Jindal Steel और CSIR-CRRI द्वारा steel slag से 1.85 km लंबी, चार-लेन सड़क बनाई गई है।
A 1.85-km, four-lane road has been constructed from steel slag by Jindal Steel and CSIR-CRRI in Raigarh, Chhattisgarh.

14 September 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

➼ 18वें BRICS Summit में स्वीकृत संयुक्त घोषणापत्र का आधिकारिक नाम New Delhi Declaration है।
The official name of the joint declaration adopted at the 18th BRICS Summit is New Delhi Declaration.

➼ भारत द्वारा आयोजित 18वें BRICS Summit 2026 की आधिकारिक थीम “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability” थी।
The official theme of the 18th BRICS Summit 2026 hosted by India was “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.”

➼ China वर्ष 2027 में BRICS की अध्यक्षता संभालेगा और BRICS Summit की मेजबानी करेगा।
China will assume the BRICS chairmanship and host the summit in 2027.

➼ मानसिक स्वास्थ्य के लिए BRICS ‘Network of Centres of Excellence’ के coordinating centre के रूप में NIMHANS, Bengaluru को नामित किया गया है।
NIMHANS, Bengaluru has been designated as the coordinating centre for the BRICS ‘Network of Centres of Excellence’ for mental health.

➼ प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने संकट में नाविकों की सहायता के लिए Seafarers’ Emergency Support Network पहल का प्रस्ताव रखा।
Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed the Seafarers’ Emergency Support Network to assist seafarers during distress.

➼ 18वें BRICS Summit के दौरान Bharat Mandapam में वैश्विक नेताओं के स्वागत के लिए Ramanathaswamy Temple, Rameswaram की पृष्ठभूमि प्रदर्शित की गई।
The backdrop of Ramanathaswamy Temple, Rameswaram was displayed at Bharat Mandapam to welcome global leaders during the 18th BRICS Summit.

➼ BRICS Summit 2026 में कृषि आदानों और आनुवंशिक संसाधनों को जोड़ने के लिए BRICS AGRIN (Agro-Inputs, Genetic Resources, and Information Network) की स्थापना पर सहमति बनी।
The BRICS Summit 2026 agreed to establish BRICS AGRIN (Agro-Inputs, Genetic Resources, and Information Network) to connect agro-inputs and genetic resources.

➼ भारत और इंडोनेशिया ने वर्ष 2026–2027 को Tagore-Dewantara Year घोषित किया है।
India and Indonesia have declared 2026–2027 as the Tagore-Dewantara Year.

➼ UAE की International Holding Company (IHC) ने Odisha में $11.5 billion integrated greenfield aluminium project में निवेश की घोषणा की है।
UAE’s International Holding Company (IHC) announced an investment in a $11.5 billion integrated greenfield aluminium project in Odisha.

➼ China Southern Airlines ने छह वर्षों के बाद New Delhi और Guangzhou के बीच सीधी यात्री उड़ानें फिर शुरू करने की घोषणा की है।
China Southern Airlines announced the resumption of direct passenger flights between New Delhi and Guangzhou after a six-year gap.

➼ भूजल संकट के कारण ‘ghost village’ बनने को लेकर चर्चा में रहा Gattumidapalle village, Annamayya district आंध्र प्रदेश में स्थित है।
Gattumidapalle village in Annamayya district is located in Andhra Pradesh and was recently in the news for becoming a ‘ghost village’ due to a groundwater crisis.

➼ विवादित ऐतिहासिक दावों को लेकर चर्चा में रही Lat Masjid मध्य प्रदेश में स्थित है।
The historic Lat Masjid, recently in the news over disputed historical claims, is located in Madhya Pradesh.

➼ इंडोनेशिया के Sulawesi में 25,000 वर्ष पुराने मानव अवशेषों में arecoline मिलने से Betel Nut (सुपारी) के उपयोग का सबसे प्राचीन प्रमाण मिला है।
The discovery of arecoline in 25,000-year-old human remains from Sulawesi provided the oldest evidence of Betel Nut use.

➼ इंग्लैंड के Joe Root ने अपना 69वां टेस्ट अर्धशतक बनाकर Sachin Tendulkar के 68 टेस्ट अर्धशतकों का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ दिया।
England’s Joe Root broke Sachin Tendulkar’s record of 68 Test half-centuries by scoring his 69th Test half-century.

➼ Kateřina Siniaková और Taylor Townsend ने 2026 US Open Women’s Doubles का खिताब जीता।
Kateřina Siniaková and Taylor Townsend won the 2026 US Open Women’s Doubles title.

13 September 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

➼ केंद्र सरकार ने देश के सभी टोल प्लाजा को मार्च 2027 तक बैरियर-मुक्त बनाने का लक्ष्य रखा है।
The Central Government has set a target to make all toll plazas in the country barrier-free by March 2027.

➼ ISRO के EOS-06 उपग्रह ने प्रशांत महासागर में शक्तिशाली ‘Godzilla El Nino’ मौसम पैटर्न के शुरुआती संकेतों का पता लगाया है।
ISRO’s EOS-06 satellite detected early signs of the powerful ‘Godzilla El Nino’ weather pattern in the Pacific Ocean.

➼ भारत और रूस ने 2030 तक वार्षिक द्विपक्षीय व्यापार को 100 अरब डॉलर तक बढ़ाने का लक्ष्य रखा है।
India and Russia have resolved to increase their annual bilateral trade to $100 billion by 2030.

➼ प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन को प्राचीन तमिल ग्रंथ ‘तिरुक्कुरल’ का रूसी अनुवाद भेंट किया।
Prime Minister Narendra Modi presented Russian President Vladimir Putin with the Russian translation of the ancient Tamil text ‘Thirukkural’.

➼ रणनीतिक पेरिम द्वीप (Perim Island) बाब-अल-मंदेब जलडमरूमध्य में स्थित है।
The strategic Perim Island is located in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

➼ सितंबर 2026 में रूस को पीछे छोड़कर भारत विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार के मामले में विश्व में चौथे स्थान पर पहुंच गया है।
In September 2026, India surpassed Russia to become the 4th largest country globally in terms of foreign exchange reserves.

➼ RBI ने फिनटेक क्षेत्र के लिए नए Self-Regulatory Organization Unified Fintech Forum (SRO-FT) को मान्यता दी है।
The RBI recognized Unified Fintech Forum as the new Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO-FT) for the fintech sector.

➼ BRICS Summit 2026 के अवसर पर Bharat Mandapam में Bharat Innovates Exposition के तहत 37 deep-tech innovations प्रदर्शित किए गए।
37 deep-tech innovations were showcased at Bharat Mandapam under the Bharat Innovates Exposition during BRICS Summit 2026.

➼ ULPIN (Bhu-Aadhaar) एक 14 अंकों का Universal Land Parcel Identification Number है।
ULPIN (Bhu-Aadhaar) is a 14-digit Universal Land Parcel Identification Number.

➼ सितंबर 2026 में अधिसूचित National Sports Election Panel में 20 सदस्य शामिल किए गए हैं।
The National Sports Election Panel notified in September 2026 consists of 20 members.

➼ ईशान किशन को Duleep Trophy 2026 के फाइनल में Player of the Match चुना गया।
Ishan Kishan was named Player of the Match in the Duleep Trophy 2026 final.

➼ कर्नाटक कैबिनेट ने औद्योगिक निवेश को बढ़ावा देने के लिए Aerospace Policy 2026-31 को मंजूरी दी है।
The Karnataka Cabinet approved the Aerospace Policy 2026-31 to promote industrial investment.

➼ भारत ने अमेरिका और 24 अन्य देशों के साथ Next-Generation Global 6G Network Initiative में शामिल होने की घोषणा की है।
India, along with the US and 24 other countries, announced joining the next-generation global 6G network initiative.

➼ असम के जोरहाट जिले में राजेश बोरदोलोई को ‘Each One Teach One’ पहल के तहत National Teachers’ Award 2026 से सम्मानित किया गया।
Rajesh Bordoloi from Assam’s Jorhat district was honoured with the National Teachers’ Award 2026 under the ‘Each One Teach One’ initiative.

➼ Axis Bank ने ‘Act with Speed’ थीम के साथ Sparsh Week 2026 लॉन्च किया है।
Axis Bank launched Sparsh Week 2026 with the theme ‘Act with Speed’.

12 September 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

➼ वर्ष 2026 में विस्तारित BRICS समूह में कुल 11 पूर्ण सदस्य देश शामिल हैं।
In 2026, the expanded BRICS group has 11 full member countries.

➼ मिस्र के El Alamein International Airshow में भारतीय वायुसेना की Sarang Helicopter Display Team ने भाग लिया।
The Indian Air Force’s Sarang Helicopter Display Team participated in the El Alamein International Airshow in Egypt.

➼ पहला India-Russia International Industrial Trade Fair (INNOPROM.India) सितंबर 2026 में New Delhi में आयोजित किया गया।
The first India-Russia International Industrial Trade Fair (INNOPROM.India) was held in New Delhi in September 2026.

➼ सितंबर 2026 में International Space Summit का आयोजन Paris, France में हुआ, जिसे प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने वर्चुअल रूप से संबोधित किया।
The International Space Summit was held in Paris, France, and was virtually addressed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

➼ भारत और अमेरिका की सेनाओं के बीच Yudh Abhyas 2026 का 22वां संस्करण सितंबर 2026 में शुरू हुआ।
The 22nd edition of Yudh Abhyas 2026 between the Indian and US armies began in September 2026.

➼ भारतीय नौसेना का sail training ship INS Sudarshini सितंबर 2026 में Livorno port, Italy पहुंचा।
Indian Navy’s sail training ship INS Sudarshini reached Livorno port, Italy in September 2026.

➼ अहमदाबाद में आयोजित World Archery Para Series 2026 Stage-3 में भारत ने कुल 15 पदक — 4 स्वर्ण, 3 रजत और 8 कांस्य जीते।
India won a total of 15 medals — 4 gold, 3 silver and 8 bronze in Stage-3 of the World Archery Para Series 2026 held in Ahmedabad.

➼ भारत ने अपना स्वदेशी Bharatiya Antariksha Station वर्ष 2035 तक स्थापित करने का लक्ष्य रखा है।
India has set a target to establish its indigenous Bharatiya Antariksha Station by 2035.

➼ IISc Bengaluru और Technical University of Denmark के वैज्ञानिकों ने Cobra venom के खिलाफ प्रभावी antivenom विकसित किया।
Scientists from IISc Bengaluru and the Technical University of Denmark developed an effective antivenom against cobra venom.

➼ Lemru Elephant Reserve छत्तीसगढ़ में स्थित है और हाल ही में coal mining corridors के संदर्भ में चर्चा में रहा।
The Lemru Elephant Reserve is located in Chhattisgarh and was recently in the news in the context of coal mining corridors.

➼ East Zone ने 14 साल के अंतराल के बाद सितंबर 2026 में प्रतिष्ठित Duleep Trophy का खिताब जीता।
East Zone won the prestigious Duleep Trophy title in September 2026 after a gap of 14 years.

➼ MoSPI के नवीनतम जिला-स्तरीय आंकड़ों में Nirmal, Telangana में informal workers में महिलाओं की हिस्सेदारी लगभग 78% दर्ज की गई।
According to the latest district-level data of MoSPI, Nirmal, Telangana recorded the highest share of women among informal workers at approximately 78%.

➼ Saima Wazed ने सितंबर 2026 में WHO South-East Asia Region की Regional Director के पद से इस्तीफा दिया।
Saima Wazed resigned as the Regional Director of the WHO South-East Asia Region in September 2026.

➼ सितंबर 2026 में जारी autobiography ‘Aprajita’ की लेखिका Arundhati Bhattacharya हैं।
Arundhati Bhattacharya is the author of the autobiography ‘Aprajita’, released in September 2026.

➼ Delhi Government ने सितंबर 2026 में अपनी State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) गठित करने की घोषणा की।
The Delhi Government announced the formation of its own State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) in September 2026.

The 12th IPU Global Conference of Young Parliamentarians was held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.

Indore secured the second position in Category-1 of Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2026.

➼ DRDO ने ‘Arudhra’ नामक स्वदेशी 4D रडार प्रणाली विकसित की है।
DRDO has indigenously developed the ‘Arudhra’ 4D radar system.

➼ सशस्त्र बलों के कर्मियों के लिए कागजी पहचान पत्रों की जगह DEFSAC (Defence Forces Secure Access Card) System के RFID आधारित स्मार्ट पहचान पत्र को मंजूरी दी गई है।
The DEFSAC (Defence Forces Secure Access Card) System has been approved to replace paper identity cards with RFID-based smart identity cards for armed forces personnel.

➼ रासायनिक, जैविक और रेडियोधर्मी तत्वों से दूषित क्षेत्रों की पहचान और निगरानी के लिए CBRN Reconnaissance Vehicle की खरीद को मंजूरी दी गई है।
The procurement of CBRN Reconnaissance Vehicles has been approved to identify and monitor areas contaminated with chemical, biological and radiological elements.

➼ CMFRI, Kochi ने मछलियों की लंबाई और चौड़ाई बिना स्पर्श किए मापने के लिए MatsyaMetri स्मार्टफोन ऐप विकसित किया है।
CMFRI, Kochi developed the MatsyaMetri smartphone app for non-contact measurement of the length and width of fishes.

➼ Tewolde Gebremariam को Campbell Wilson के स्थान पर Air India का नया CEO और MD नियुक्त किया गया है।
Tewolde Gebremariam has been appointed as the new CEO and MD of Air India, replacing Campbell Wilson.

➼ 72वें National Film Awards समारोह का आयोजन पांच दशकों से अधिक समय बाद पहली बार नई दिल्ली से बाहर एकता नगर, गुजरात में किया जा रहा है।
The 72nd National Film Awards ceremony is being held outside New Delhi for the first time in over five decades at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat.

➼ ‘Article 370’ को 72वें National Film Awards में Best Feature Film का पुरस्कार मिला।
‘Article 370’ was awarded Best Feature Film at the 72nd National Film Awards.

➼ यामी गौतम ने ‘Article 370’ के लिए 72वें National Film Awards में Best Actress in a Leading Role का पुरस्कार जीता।
Yami Gautam won the Best Actress in a Leading Role award for ‘Article 370’ at the 72nd National Film Awards.

➼ श्रीनगर में शुरू हुए जम्मू-कश्मीर के पहले International Film Festival का नाम ‘Rang-e-Cinema’ रखा गया है।
The first International Film Festival of Jammu and Kashmir, which commenced in Srinagar, has been named ‘Rang-e-Cinema’.

➼ Jamrani Dam Multipurpose Project उत्तराखंड में स्थित है और हाल ही में पुनर्वास कार्यों के कारण चर्चा में रही।
The Jamrani Dam Multipurpose Project is located in Uttarakhand and was recently in the news for rehabilitation works.

06 September 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

आज का सुविचार
जित और हार आपकी सोच पर निर्भर करती हैं,
मान लो तो हार होगी और ठान लो तो जीत होगी।

➼ EOS-05 को ISRO ने GSLV-F17 प्रक्षेपण यान द्वारा लॉन्च किया।
ISRO launched EOS-05 using the GSLV-F17 launch vehicle.

➼ CBI ने 20 राज्यों में ‘Digital Arrest’ साइबर धोखाधड़ी गिरोहों के खिलाफ Operation Chakra-VI अभियान चलाया।
The CBI launched Operation Chakra-VI across 20 states against ‘digital arrest’ cyber fraud gangs.

➼ हरियाणा ने लुधियाना में आयोजित 21वीं National Youth Athletics Championships की पदक तालिका में शीर्ष स्थान हासिल किया।
Haryana topped the medal tally at the 21st National Youth Athletics Championships held in Ludhiana.

➼ बेंगलुरु में Global Chess League (GCL) के चौथे संस्करण का आयोजन किया गया।
The fourth edition of the Global Chess League (GCL) was held in Bengaluru.

➼ श्री गुरु गोरखनाथ कम्युनिटी रिजर्व हरियाणा में स्थित है और यह कछुआ संरक्षण को लेकर चर्चा में रहा।
The Shri Guru Gorakhnath Community Reserve is located in Haryana and was recently in the news for turtle conservation.

➼ कर्नाटक ने महिलाओं में पेरिमेनोपॉज और मेनोपॉज देखभाल के लिए देश की पहली समर्पित स्वास्थ्य नीति ‘Ruthu Thare’ शुरू की।
Karnataka launched ‘Ruthu Thare’, India’s first dedicated health policy focusing on perimenopause and menopause care in women.

➼ उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार ने मथुरा-वृंदावन (ब्रज) क्षेत्र के 200 प्राचीन स्मारकों और धरोहर स्थलों के संरक्षण के लिए तीर्थ मित्र योजना शुरू करने का निर्णय लिया है।
The Uttar Pradesh Government has decided to launch the Teerth Mitra Scheme for conserving 200 ancient monuments and heritage sites in the Mathura-Vrindavan (Braj) region.

➼ SEBI ने केंद्रीय प्रतिपक्षकारों (CCPs) पर सूचना साझा करने और सहयोग के लिए European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) के साथ संशोधित MoU पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
SEBI signed a revised MoU with the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) for information sharing and cooperation on Central Counterparties (CCPs).

➼ Yashovardhan Azad ‘Policing the Republic’ पुस्तक के लेखक हैं।
Yashovardhan Azad is the author of the book ‘Policing the Republic’.

➼ United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) ने ‘Limiting Overshoot’ रिपोर्ट जारी की।
The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) released the ‘Limiting Overshoot’ report.

➼ UNEP की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार वर्तमान नीतियों के चलते 2100 तक वैश्विक तापमान में लगभग 2.6°C की वृद्धि हो सकती है।
According to the UNEP report, global temperatures could rise by around 2.6°C by 2100 under current policies.

➼ Gollala Gudi Temple को ASI द्वारा ‘राष्ट्रीय महत्व का स्मारक’ घोषित किया गया और यह तेलंगाना में स्थित है।
The Gollala Gudi Temple, declared a ‘Monument of National Importance’ by the ASI, is located in Telangana.

➼ भारत 2026 में BRICS की चौथी बार अध्यक्षता कर रहा है।
India is holding the BRICS presidency for the fourth time in 2026.

➼ भारत 2027 में पहली ICC Women’s Champions Trophy की मेजबानी करेगा।
India will host the first ICC Women’s Champions Trophy in 2027.

➼ अहमदाबाद में भारत में पहली बार World Archery Para Series 2026 के तीसरे चरण का आयोजन किया जा रहा है।
The third stage of the World Archery Para Series 2026 is being organized for the first time in India in Ahmedabad.
